title: Receptionist
description:

title: Data Protection Administrator
description:
Here's a professional job advert based on your notes:

Data Protection Administrator (SARs)

Remote Full-Time Temporary (2-4 Weeks)

We are currently seeking an experienced Data Protection Administrator to support our clients team on a temporary basis for an initial 2-4 week assignment. This role will focus on managing a backlog of Subject Access Requests (SARs) and ensuring requests are processed accurately and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing and managing Subject Access Requests (SARs) in line with GDPR and data protection requirements.
- Working through an existing backlog of SAR requests.
- Managing a shared inbox and responding to SAR-related enquiries.
- Maintaining and updating request tracking logs and reporting tools.
- Liaising with internal stakeholders and IT teams to gather required information.
- Reviewing requests and advising on the information required to progress cases.
- Supporting the end-to-end SAR process to ensure requests are completed within required timescales.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience processing Subject Access Requests (SARs).
- Strong understanding of GDPR and data protection principles.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Ability to manage multiple requests and prioritise workload effectively.
- Experience maintaining trackers and administrative records.
- Confident communicating with stakeholders across different business areas.
- Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Contract Details
- Duration: 2-4 weeks
- Hours: Full-time
- Location: Fully remote
- Start Date: Immediate start available

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Data Protection professional looking for a short-term assignment with an immediate impact.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age

title: Dispatch Administrator
description:
Job Title Dispatch Administrator

Location: Forfar

Contract Type Temporary Assignment - Minimum 3 to 4 weeks (potential for extension or permanent contract)

Hours 37.5 Hours per Week

Shift Pattern Day shift, Monday to Friday - flexible start and end Times

Pay: 15.27 an hour

Start Date Immediate start available, subject to a successful interview.

Are you an organised and detail-oriented administrator looking for your next opportunity?

We're currently recruiting for a Dispatch Administrator to join a busy manufacturing and distribution environment on a temporary basis. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced setting and enjoys coordinating processes, maintaining accurate records and ensuring operations run smoothly.

Working as part of a supportive team, you will play a key role in the dispatch function, helping to ensure products are delivered accurately, efficiently and on time.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate the dispatch and transportation of goods to customers.
- Ensure orders are processed accurately and delivered within agreed timescales.
- Maintain accurate dispatch records and documentation.
- Produce regular reports and analyse dispatch-related information.
- Process and check transport invoices and associated paperwork.
- Support wider operational and administrative reporting activities.
- Liaise with internal departments and external transport partners to ensure efficient service delivery.
- Provide general administrative support to the operations team as required.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within an administration role
- Strong organisational and planning skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications.
- The ability to prioritise workload and manage multiple tasks effectively.
- A proactive and reliable approach to work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Experience within dispatch, logistics, transport, warehouse or manufacturing environments would be highly advantageous.
- Experience with Microsoft Office Package is also an advantage

What's on Offer
- 37.5 paid hours per week.
- Day shift working pattern.
- Competitive salary of 15.27 an hour
- Weekly pay.
- Supportive and friendly working environment.
- Immediate start available following a successful interview.
- Potential for the assignment to be extended based on business requirements.

Apply Now

This role would suit an experienced administrator who enjoys working in a fast-paced operational environment and can hit the ground running.

If you're available to start at short notice and have the skills and experience we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to be considered for an immediate interview.
